title: Which driver will take pole position for the inaugural Freedom 250 Grand Prix in Washington, DC?
background: Pole position is the first starting spot on the grid, awarded through qualifying.
resolution_criteria:
Source of Truth : Resolve to the driver credited with pole position in IndyCar's official qualifying results for the inaugural Freedom 250 Grand Prix, scheduled for August 23, 2026, in Washington, DC.  
       Resolution Date : 2026-08-22  
       Accepted Answer Format : Answer with the driver's full name.
